textRuns.value: A country by year panel, 2016 to 2025, with country fixed effects, so each country is compared with itself, and each metric is measured in units of the typical year-to-year spread within a country (11.7 days for high-danger days). Of four weather metrics, only high-danger days and spring drought (SPEI) are robust: their 95 % interval excludes zero and the sign holds in every variant tested. Temperature and rainfall cannot be told apart from zero (grey bars below, robust ones in orange). The weather-adjusted area is what each year would have burnt under that country's average weather, all four terms included.
